data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria

- New staff applicant cards presented in MainStreetRenderer with distinct visuals (skills displayed)
- Animations + SFX wired per AGENTS.md conventions (deal/discard/flip helpers with soundManager + sfx, COMMON_SFX_KEYS)
- SLL layouts used, no hardcoded pixel positions
- Reduced-motion preferences respected
- Help panel / UI shows staff skill information to the player

## Implementation
- Update MainStreetRenderer.ts to render staff cards with skill badges/indicators
- Wire MainStreetAnimator.ts animations + SFX following GolfAnimator reference pattern
- Use SLL anchor-based positioning for staff card UI
- Respect reduced-motion flag (explicit flag → SettingsStore toggle → prefers-reduced-motion)
- Play SFX through SoundManager with COMMON_SFX_KEYS convention
- Document any UI choices in scene help text
data.title: Update rendering & animation for staff cards
